purpose: Requirements for the immutable configuration committed by one PoolActionFv1 pool instance. This is not a deployable configuration and deliberately contains no fabricated genesis, primitive, security, or carrier selection.

commitsTo: state token category and mutable capability
protocol template digest over normalized typed script templates
note commitment and authorization algorithm IDs
note accumulator algorithm ID and capacity
nullifier derivation and set-accumulator algorithm IDs
excludes: genesis state transaction ID or outpoint
concrete state or carrier locking bytecode containing poolInstanceId or carrierManifestDigest
hashes of those instantiated locking bytecodes
poolIdentity.rule: The selected digest algorithm and every committed field are immutable after genesis. The deployment anchor exists before the genesis transaction. The pool identity may commit only normalized templates with typed placeholders, never bytes or an outpoint derived from the identity itself. A runtime algorithm or parameter selector is forbidden.

identityDerivationDag.rule: Every edge is left-to-right and acyclic. No digest may include its own instantiated bytes, directly or through a transaction ID.

dependsOn: canonical relation, state, statement, and transaction-context codec versions
normalized state-covenant and verifier-role templates with typed deployment placeholders
selected algorithm IDs and proof security profile
state token category and mutable capability
fixed ticket, base, capacity, algorithms, security profile, fee policy, and no-upgrade fields
role ordinals, values, token records, proof-section schedule, and proof security profile
mustNotContain: hashes of concrete instantiated carrier locking bytecode

outputs: exact state and carrier locking bytecodes

scriptPinning: The state covenant pins poolInstanceId, protocolTemplateDigest, and carrierManifestDigest and preserves its exact instantiated successor lock.
Each carrier pins the same three digests plus its role ordinal and preserves its exact instantiated successor lock.
The carrier manifest authenticates normalized templates and role data; it never hashes a concrete lock containing carrierManifestDigest.
The post-genesis deployment record maps the committed identities to exact deployed lock hashes and outpoints but is not an input to an upstream identity digest.

requiredInstantiationFields.requirement: One explicit BCH network identifier; cross-network replay must fail.

Canonical wire-order txid plus uint32 output index of a pre-existing UTXO consumed by genesis. It is fixed before poolInstanceId or the genesis transaction exists and anchors the pool and token-issuance lineage.
One category with mutable capability and fungible amount exactly zero; the issuance history must prove no surviving minting authority can create a confusing state clone.
Digest of canonical typed script templates and protocol codecs with explicit placeholders. It contains no deployment ID, concrete instantiated lock, or genesis transaction-derived value.

Canonical normalized template plus exact instantiated locking bytecode and digest. The template is upstream of poolInstanceId; the instantiated bytes are downstream and every successor state output must preserve them exactly.
A fixed token-aware standard value preserved across all actions and included in the reserve equation.

Maximum number of deposits over this pool instance's lifetime. Once depositCount reaches it, all later deposits reject permanently while valid withdrawals remain enabled; it is selected so every count and satoshi equation remains consensus-valid without overflow.
A selected 32-byte binding commitment with canonical encoding and domain separation.
A selected knowledge-of-preimage authorization relation for the private spend path; classical dependencies must be disclosed.
Append-at-public-index accumulator with canonical empty leaf, root encoding, path ordering, and fixed capacity.
A selected 32-byte derivation binding pool, note index, owner secret, and rho.
Authenticated non-membership plus deterministic insertion; append-only membership alone is insufficient.
A selected 32-byte binding digest over the canonical non-circular transaction context.
Commits the selected field, tower, circle domain, hashes, ZK masking, AIR, FRI schedule, encodings, and full soundness worksheet.

At least one verifier role; exact input count, role order, normalized lock-template identities, values, token records, proof-section schedule, and lifecycle. Its digest binds poolInstanceId but excludes concrete locks containing that digest; exact deployed locks are recorded and self-preserved downstream.
Exactly one external signed funding input, zero or one fixed-position transparent change output, and an immutable maximum fee.

postGenesisRecordFields.requirement: Recorded after the genesis transaction is constructed. It identifies the initial state UTXO for reconstruction and is never an input to poolInstanceId, protocolTemplateDigest, or carrierManifestDigest.
Recorded after genesis in carrier-manifest order; never an input to an upstream identity digest.
Exact state and carrier locking-bytecode hashes, together with template-instantiation evidence. These audit records are downstream outputs, not self-committed identity inputs.

finiteLifetimeDecision.rule: The append-only note accumulator has a fixed maxLifetimeDeposits. Reaching it permanently disables new deposits for this pool instance but never disables otherwise valid withdrawals of existing unspent notes.
finiteLifetimeDecision.recovery: A later pool instance may use a new deployment anchor and identity; Fv1 provides no migration, rollover, admin, or privileged transfer path.
finiteLifetimeDecision.disclosure: Wallets and deployment tooling must display total capacity, remaining deposit slots, and the no-migration boundary.

lineageRequirements: The genesis transaction consumes the pre-existing deployment anchor, creates the unique state token lineage, and contains the already-derived poolInstanceId in the state commitment.
Genesis creates exactly one mutable state NFT for the category, creates no second confusing state NFT, and leaves no minting or privileged authority.
Genesis creates one state output at index zero and every carrier output at indices one through N in manifest order as one lineage bundle.
The chain-derived tip is the sole unspent mutable state NFT reachable from the post-genesis recorded state outpoint through valid PoolActionFv1 transitions.
The state input is transaction input zero and the successor state is output zero.

For carrier ordinal i, the source outpoint transaction ID equals the state source outpoint transaction ID and its source index is i+1; every action successor recreates the same bundle at output indices zero through N.
Every action consumes and recreates every verifier carrier in its manifest with the same value and exact successor lock.
No action requires a carrier warehouse, replenisher, coordinator, or extra setup transaction.
The state and carrier lineage may not be changed by a runtime version or migration path.
selectionBlocks: network and pre-existing deployment anchor outpoint
normalized protocol templates and protocol template digest
post-genesis state/carrier outpoint and deployed-lock records
state token issuance and minting-authority destruction evidence
field, extension tower, and circle domain
commitment, authorization, nullifier, transcript, and Merkle primitives
maximum fee and token-aware carrier values
